Musepack streaminfo_* row, not reconstructed under the Musepack rule. 7-bit profile scaled by 0.125 at +0x150, version name from a table, 1-bit flag at +0x14c, 24-bit value at +0x48, then mpc_get_encoder_string. Upstream libmusepack name not confirmed.

RandomGroup C1, same body as C2 0x881ad0. Asm (0x881b40) writes the SegmentGroup vptr, +0x24..+0x2c, the removed-list sentinel (+0x30, +0x34), +0x3c, +0x40, +0x48 and +0x58 only. Missing (one item): the values of +0x38 (element count), +0x44 (current index), +0x50 and +0x54, which neither this constructor nor SegmentGroup C2 (0x8818d4) writes. The port's 0, -1, 0, 0 are defaults, not binary values.

RandomGroup::SetState(RandomGroup&): base copy, scalars, the copy of the source element pointers and the surplus/relink paths match the asm. Missing (one item): when the removed list is empty and this vector is shorter than the source, the original pushes the word at sentinel+8 (this+0x38, the element count) as an element pointer; the port pushes null, since a 64-bit port cannot hold that word as a pointer.

UpdateCurrentSegmentState: index -1 branch and no-rule tail kept. Missing (one item): the element branch (a2 type 6 path), which needs the std::vector<int> copy of the loop-list entry (as 0x8847e8) and the results of vtable slots 0x1c and 0x20.

IMA DecodeSegment: loop and stop logic transcribed, DecodeBlock and the decoding-slot virtual ported. Missing (one item): the UpdateSegmentsStates call (0x885740, partial: its element lookup assumes the next_event_ loop-list length).

IMA DecodeCurrentSegmentWithOffset: pending-frame zeroing and loop transcribed. Missing (one item): the UpdateSegmentsStates call (0x885740, partial: its element lookup assumes the next_event_ loop-list length). No test drives the loop.

StreamCFileCursor::Init: asm 0x888728 checks the owner and the handle, then opens owner->fs_ with the owner's name word (+0x1c, the string data pointer, port path_.c_str()) and mode 6, storing the handle at +0x08. An empty name is opened too, as in the asm. The port returns early when the owner's fs is null, where the original would call through null. Name word resolved (NOTES.md wave 13).

StreamCFile::Init, matched to asm 0x888a60: size reset, fs = GetInstance() stored at +0x20, return when the string is empty (+0x18 == +0x1c) or fs is null, OpenFile(name, 6), Seek(0, 2), size = Tell(), CloseFile through fs vtable +0x0c. Name word is the string data pointer (+0x1c), port path_.c_str().

LoadXML: file read, then sound, group, mask, bank and event chunk loops, with the sound loop stale-uid slot and the priority word (wave 11). Missing (one item): the uid stack slots of the group, bank and event loops; the group loop reads its uid into var_118 (asm 0x88df04) and the bank and event uid queries are not traced. A group, bank or event without a uid is skipped until those are traced.

FillBufferStereo16NoInter: unity-scale stereo mix transcribed. Missing (one item): the ramp hand-off after a buffer ends mid-block (the ARM LABEL_29/LABEL_30 path that sets the fraction and the ramp level) is not checked against the asm listing and no test drives it. Base virtuals +0x4c and +0x58 are not called here.

FillBufferStereo16: interpolating stereo mix from the scratch copy transcribed. Missing (one item): the ramp hand-off between two blocks (the ARM path after the ramp is set) is not checked against the asm listing and no test drives it.

FillBufferMono16NoInter: unity-scale mono mix with per-channel ramps transcribed. Missing (one item): the per-channel ramp hand-off after the ramp is set (ARM path) is not checked against the asm listing and no test drives it.

FillBufferMono16: interpolating mono mix from the scratch copy transcribed. Missing (one item): the ramp hand-off between two blocks (the ARM path after the ramp is set) is not checked against the asm listing and no test drives it.

Copy constructor: memberwise copy of the pthread mutex word (asm and Hex-Rays). The port deletes copy for std::mutex; not reproduced.
Copy constructor (C2): memberwise copy of the pthread mutex word. The port deletes copy for std::mutex; not reproduced.

GetCurThreadId: POSIX builds return pthread_self(), as the original does. Missing (one item): the Windows value; pthread_t has no Windows equivalent, so the port returns a hash of std::thread::id there.

VoxThread C1: name, callback, thread start and the priority step (max if max <= 30, else max(min, 31)) are ported on POSIX with pthread_setschedparam. Missing (one item): the priority step on Windows, since no SetThreadPriority mapping is defined for it.
VoxThread C2: same body as C1. Missing (one item): the priority step on Windows, since no SetThreadPriority mapping is defined for it.

CloseFile, matched to asm 0x893ff0: null gives -1; otherwise the handle is read through the virtual GetFilePtr (vtable slot +0x18, now virtual), a nonzero handle goes to g_file_close (off_A33EC0), the file is destroyed (vtable slot 0, then VoxFree; the port allocates with new, so delete) and 0 is returned. Returns int now; callers ignore it. Test: tests/w13_close_file_test.cpp.
